d:
In November 2026, the Indian Navy successfully rescued the Iranian fishing vessel Azini from armed Somali pirates in a high-risk operation off the coast of Somalia.
The 48-hour mission involved INS Kolkata, P-8I maritime surveillance aircraft, Sea Guardian drones and MARCOS commandos deployed by the Indian Air Force's C-17 Globemaster aircraft. All 20 crew members were safely rescued. But this was not the first time India had carried out such an operation.
